method: Uniform random sampling of pending active cards, excluding dirty and reserved files and preferring scores below 93 while the other process reviews priorities. Since checkpoint eight, each selection also uses the shared claim token under .publish.lock; completion checks state, ownership and input hash. All remaining unclaimed scores are eligible once preferred candidates run out.
